body.zh-Hant: 克拉克1896年5月1日生於美國，1917年畢業於西點軍校並入伍。一戰時他在法國西線作戰，帶連隊時被彈片重傷。1941年4月他晉升准將，隔年隨艾森豪赴英國，協助規劃火炬行動。
body.en: Clark was born in the United States on 1 May 1896 and graduated from West Point in 1917 before joining the army. In the First World War he fought on the Western Front in France and was badly wounded by shrapnel while leading his company. He became a brigadier general in April 1941 and the next year went to Britain with Eisenhower, where he helped plan Operation Torch.

body.en: In 1942 Clark commanded II Corps, and on 13 October 1942 he became the US Army's youngest three-star general. He then commanded the 5th Army in Italy until December 1944, when he took command of the 15th Army Group.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年9月9日，克拉克率部在薩勒諾搶灘登陸義大利，遭遇強烈抵抗，靠蒙哥馬利第八集團軍協助才在9月15日穩住灘頭。他在卡西諾難以突破，最後轉由瓦爾蒙托內主攻。1944年5月18日波蘭軍與法軍攻占卡西諾山，部隊於6月4日解放羅馬。
body.en: On 9 September 1943 Clark's troops made an amphibious assault at Salerno and met serious resistance; with help from Montgomery's 8th Army the beachhead was secured by 15 September. He had difficulty taking Cassino and eventually made his main effort through Valmontone. After Polish and French corps captured Monte Cassino on 18 May 1944, he took his forces to Rome, which he liberated on 4 June.

In April 1952 he replaced Ridgway as head of the Far East Command and UN forces, and he retired in October 1953.

body.en: Early in the war Taylor helped organize the 82nd, the US Army's first airborne division. body.zh-Hant: 井上成美（1889—1975）出身宮城縣，是海軍兵學校第37期，1909年11月畢業。他自海軍大學校畢業後，歷任駐義大利大使館武官、比叡號艦長、橫須賀鎮守府參謀長等職；1932年11月以大佐身分出任海軍省軍務局第1課長。
body.en: Inoue (1889-1975) was from Miyagi Prefecture and belonged to the 37th class of the Naval Academy, graduating in November 1909. After the Naval War College he served as naval attache in Italy, captain of the Hiei and chief of staff at Yokosuka Naval District, and in November 1932 became head of the First Section of the Naval Affairs Bureau as a captain.

昭和 7 年 11 月、海軍 省の軍務局第 1 課長（大佐）に就任します。

heading.zh-Hant: 軍務局長與航空本部長

body.zh-Hant: 1937年他就任軍務局長，與米內光政海相、山本五十六次官一同反對日德義三國同盟。1940年任航空本部長，批判軍令部的大艦巨砲主義，主張海軍空軍化；1941年1月30日他向海相提出「新軍備計畫論」，並於同年8月11日由航空本部長轉任第四艦隊司令長官。
body.en: In 1937 he became chief of the Naval Affairs Bureau and, with Navy Minister Yonai and Vice Minister Yamamoto, opposed the Tripartite Pact. As chief of the Naval Aviation Bureau in 1940 he criticised the Naval General Staff's big-ship, big-gun doctrine and urged making the navy air-centred; on 30 January 1941 he submitted his "New Armament Plan" to the navy minister, and on 11 August 1941 he moved from the Aviation Bureau to command the Fourth Fleet.

body.en: From 1941 he was Commander-in-Chief of the Fourth Fleet and in 1942 directed the Battle of the Coral Sea. In the same year he became Superintendent of the Naval Academy, where he kept English-language teaching in the curriculum, showing a rational spirit.

body.en: In the Battle of the Coral Sea in May 1942, Operation MO against Port Moresby was commanded by Vice Admiral Shigeyoshi Inoue, commander of the Fourth Fleet at Rabaul. After losing a light carrier, with the Allies still blocking the approach, Inoue cancelled the Port Moresby invasion and told Takagi to retire. Yamamoto, furious, ordered him to send the surviving carrier back to the Coral Sea, but the Americans were gone.
